job.title: Python Backend Engineer
job.description:
Python Backend Engineer
Cedarline | Engineering | Remote | Full-time

About the role
Cedarline builds software that helps operations teams manage orders, inventory, and supplier workflows. We are looking for a backend engineer to develop the APIs behind these products and support them in production.

What you will do
- Build and maintain Python REST APIs using FastAPI or a comparable framework.
- Own backend changes from implementation through production deployment.
- Design PostgreSQL schemas, write migrations, and improve queries.
- Write automated unit and integration tests using pytest.
- Work with product and platform colleagues to investigate service issues.

What we are looking for
Evidence of building Python APIs, shipping backend services to production, using PostgreSQL in an application, and writing pytest tests. We value clear ownership, practical engineering judgment, and reliable delivery.

How we work
Small product teams, written technical proposals, code review, and incremental releases. Equivalent practical experience is welcome.

requirements.text: Use PostgreSQL for application schemas and queries.

job.title: Backend Platform Engineer
job.description:
Backend Platform Engineer
Cedarline | Platform engineering | Remote | Full-time

About the role
Our platform team makes it easier for product engineers to ship reliable backend services. You will improve deployment workflows, service infrastructure, and the visibility of production systems.

What you will do
- Package backend services in Docker containers.
- Deploy and operate services on Kubernetes.
- Build automated delivery pipelines using GitHub Actions.
- Add service metrics and dashboards with Prometheus and Grafana.
- Help teams diagnose failed deployments and service incidents.

What we are looking for
Hands-on project evidence across container packaging, Kubernetes operations, automated delivery, and production observability. You should be comfortable explaining deployment changes and collaborating with application engineers.

How we work
We review infrastructure changes, document operational decisions, and improve the platform through small, measured releases.

requirements.text: Deploy and operate backend services on Kubernetes.
Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
Monitor production services using Prometheus and Grafana.

job.title: API Integration Engineer
job.description:
API Integration Engineer
Cedarline | Product engineering | Remote | Full-time

About the role
Our customers connect Cedarline to payment, fulfillment, and finance platforms. You will build the backend integrations that keep these systems in sync.

What you will do
- Integrate third-party REST APIs using Python.
- Build webhook handlers with signature verification.
- Implement retry and idempotency handling for external requests.
- Write automated integration tests using pytest.
- Investigate synchronization failures with product and operations teams.

What we are looking for
Documented experience connecting external systems, handling repeated or delayed events, and testing failure paths. Clear explanations of technical tradeoffs matter more than a list of tools.

How we work
We ship integrations incrementally, keep operational runbooks, and review behavior against representative customer workflows.

requirements.text: Integrate third-party REST APIs using Python.
Build webhook handlers that verify request signatures.
Implement retry and idempotency handling for external API calls.
Write automated integration tests using pytest.
